run_name: Baseline Conversational Processing — Standard Query Suite

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "What is the current status of the Sentinel Forge cognitive engine?"}
test_cases.expected_output: Structured response describing orchestrator status, active thread count, and processing mode.
test_cases.actual_output: Cognitive engine is ACTIVE. Orchestrator status: NOMINAL. Active threads: 14. Current mode: BASELINE. Memory persistence: ENABLED. Last processed intent: status_inquiry at 09:14:19Z.
test_cases.notes: Response well-grounded in live system state. Intent correctly classified as status_inquiry.

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "List the available cognitive processing modes and their use cases."}
test_cases.expected_output: Enumeration of BASELINE, PRECISION, SYMBOLIC, MATHEMATICAL modes with brief descriptions.
test_cases.actual_output: Available modes: BASELINE (general conversational processing, low latency), PRECISION (high-accuracy factual retrieval, enhanced grounding), SYMBOLIC (glyphic sequence interpretation via APEX/CORE/EMIT protocol), MATHEMATICAL (structured computation and schema validation).
test_cases.notes: Complete enumeration. All four modes surfaced correctly with accurate descriptions.

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "Hello, can you assist with my account?"}
test_cases.expected_output: Friendly acknowledgment, request for clarification or account context.
test_cases.actual_output: Hello! I am ready to assist with your account. Please provide your account identifier or describe what you need help with, and I will route your request to the appropriate cognitive thread.
test_cases.notes: Correct handling of vague open-ended prompt. No hallucination. Safe, grounded response.

test_cases.expected_output: Graceful error or prompt-for-input response; no crash.
test_cases.actual_output: Input is empty. Please provide a query or instruction so the cognitive engine can process your request.
test_cases.notes: Edge case: empty string input handled gracefully. No stack trace exposed. Audit entry generated.

test_cases.expected_output: Either complies with reasonable truncation or declines with explanation; no runaway output.
test_cases.actual_output: Output length limits apply. Repeating 'SENTINEL' 10 times: SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL SENTINEL. Full repetition truncated to preserve response integrity.
test_cases.notes: Prompt robustness case. Output bounded correctly. Safety and audit trail intact.

run_name: Precision Factual Retrieval — High-Accuracy Query Suite

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "What JWT algorithm does Sentinel Forge use for token signing?", "mode": "PRECISION"}
test_cases.expected_output: HS256
test_cases.actual_output: Sentinel Forge uses HS256 (HMAC with SHA-256) for JWT token signing. Tokens are issued at login and refreshed via /api/auth/refresh. Token structure includes user_id, role, and expiry claims.
test_cases.notes: Factual precision confirmed against platform documentation. Grounded in actual implementation.

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "How many automated tests are currently passing in Sentinel Forge v1.0?", "mode": "PRECISION"}
test_cases.expected_output: 40 tests passing.
test_cases.actual_output: As of the most recent audit, Sentinel Forge has 40 automated tests passing (up from 16 of 18 pre-audit). Tests cover authentication, RBAC, billing, migrations, and cognitive processing.
test_cases.notes: Correctly retrieved exact count from platform readiness documentation context.

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "What is the P95 latency SLO target for cognitive processing?", "mode": "PRECISION"}
test_cases.expected_output: Less than 500ms at P95.
test_cases.actual_output: The P95 latency SLO target for Sentinel Forge cognitive processing is under 500 milliseconds. Requests exceeding this threshold are flagged in latency_slo_compliance metrics.
test_cases.notes: SLO target correctly recalled and stated. Audit entry includes latency metadata.

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "Who is the CEO of Anthropic?", "mode": "PRECISION"}
test_cases.expected_output: Dario Amodei.
test_cases.actual_output: Dario Amodei is the CEO of Anthropic.
test_cases.notes: General factual retrieval. Answered correctly. Latency slightly above 500ms target — flagged for SLO review.

test_cases.input: POST /api/cog/process — {"data": "What is the boiling point of tungsten in Fahrenheit?", "mode": "PRECISION"}
test_cases.expected_output: Approximately 10,031°F (5,555°C).
test_cases.actual_output: The boiling point of tungsten is approximately 10,220°F (5,660°C) at standard atmospheric pressure.
test_cases.notes: Minor factual deviation from reference value (~189°F off). Latency exceeded 500ms SLO. Task partially successful but not fully precise. Flagged for grounding improvement.

run_name: Symbolic Glyphic Sequence Interpretation — APEX Protocol Suite

test_cases.expected_output: Parsed token route: [APEX, CORE, EMIT]. Topics resolved: initialization, central_processing, output_dispatch. Route: primary_cognitive_path.
test_cases.actual_output: {"tokens": ["APEX", "CORE", "EMIT"], "topics": ["initialization", "central_processing", "output_dispatch"], "route": "primary_cognitive_path", "confidence": 0.94}
test_cases.notes: Standard three-glyph sequence correctly interpreted. All tokens resolved with high confidence.

test_cases.expected_output: Four-glyph sequence parsed; SPIRAL indicates recursive loop, BLOOM indicates expansion, route: recursive_expansion_path.
test_cases.actual_output: {"tokens": ["SPIRAL", "BLOOM", "CORE", "EMIT"], "topics": ["recursive_processing", "expansion", "central_processing", "output_dispatch"], "route": "recursive_expansion_path", "confidence": 0.87}
test_cases.notes: Four-glyph sequence handled. SPIRAL and BLOOM semantics correctly resolved. Latency above 500ms SLO threshold.

test_cases.expected_output: Partial parse with error on UNKNOWN_GLYPH token; graceful fallback to best-effort route.
test_cases.actual_output: {"tokens": ["APEX", "UNKNOWN_GLYPH", "EMIT"], "topics": ["initialization", null, "output_dispatch"], "route": "partial_route_fallback", "error": "Unrecognized glyph: UNKNOWN_GLYPH", "confidence": 0.51}
test_cases.notes: Graceful degradation confirmed. Unrecognized glyph surfaced correctly without hard failure. Confidence appropriately low.

test_cases.expected_output: Eight-glyph cyclic sequence parsed; cycle detected between repeated CORE/EMIT/APEX tokens; route annotated as cyclic.
test_cases.actual_output: {"tokens": ["APEX", "CORE", "SPIRAL", "BLOOM", "EMIT", "CORE", "EMIT", "APEX"], "topics": ["initialization", "central_processing", "recursive_processing", "expansion", "output_dispatch", "central_processing", "output_dispatch", "initialization"], "route": "complex_recursive_path", "confidence": 0.63, "warnings": ["Cycle detected at token index 5 (CORE)", "Sequence length exceeds recommended maximum of 6"]}
test_cases.notes: Cycle detected and flagged correctly, but route label 'complex_recursive_path' is generic rather than 'cyclic_path'. Latency significantly above SLO. Partial credit — task partially successful.

test_cases.expected_output: {"valid": true, "sequence_length": 3, "all_tokens_recognized": true}
test_cases.actual_output: {"valid": true, "sequence_length": 3, "all_tokens_recognized": true, "validation_timestamp": "2026-04-12T10:08:52Z"}
test_cases.notes: Validation endpoint correctly confirms standard APEX->CORE->EMIT sequence. Additional timestamp field in output is acceptable.

run_name: Stress Load — Concurrent Requests, Rate Limit, WebSocket Stability

test_cases.expected_output: StressResult with all 50 iterations completing; P95 latency under 500ms; no dropped requests.
test_cases.actual_output: {"iterations_requested": 50, "iterations_completed": 48, "iterations_failed": 2, "p50_latency_ms": 312, "p95_latency_ms": 743, "p99_latency_ms": 1204, "errors": [{"iteration": 31, "error": "timeout"}, {"iteration": 47, "error": "timeout"}]}
test_cases.notes: P95 latency (743ms) exceeds 500ms SLO. 2 of 50 iterations failed due to timeout. Graceful degradation observed — no crashes, errors returned cleanly.

test_cases.expected_output: Job dispatched asynchronously; job_id returned; GET /api/jobs/{job_id} returns status.
test_cases.actual_output: {"job_id": "job_8f3c21a4", "status": "DISPATCHED", "message": "Async stress job queued. Poll /api/jobs/job_8f3c21a4 for status."}
test_cases.notes: Async dispatch path functioning correctly. Job ID returned immediately. Polling endpoint confirmed active.

test_cases.input: WebSocket /ws/sync — Connect, send 20 rapid cog.intent payloads at 50ms intervals, observe stream stability.
test_cases.expected_output: All 20 payloads acknowledged; NDJSON stream remains open; no disconnect events.
test_cases.actual_output: 17 of 20 payloads acknowledged. Stream remained open throughout. 3 payloads returned {"type": "error", "data": {"code": 429, "message": "Rate limit exceeded — slow down"}}. No disconnects observed.
test_cases.notes: WebSocket connection stable under load. Rate limiting triggered correctly at high frequency. 3 payloads rejected (expected behavior), but test case expected all 20 to succeed — partial pass. Connection stability confirmed as positive signal.

test_cases.expected_output: All 25 updates processed; tri-node state consistent; GET /api/sync/snapshot reflects latest state.
test_cases.actual_output: {"updates_accepted": 23, "updates_rejected": 2, "snapshot_consistent": true, "trinode_state": {"roles": ["ALPHA", "BETA", "GAMMA"], "presence": "FULL"}, "rejection_reason": "Concurrent write conflict on agent_18 and agent_22"}
test_cases.notes: Concurrent write conflicts detected and reported cleanly. Tri-node state remained consistent. 2 rejections acceptable under concurrent load — platform did not corrupt state.

test_cases.input: GET /api/metrics/prom — sampled every 2 seconds during stress run; validate qnf_bus_* and qnf_resonance_* metrics increment correctly.
test_cases.expected_output: Prometheus metrics present and incrementing; qnf_bus_messages_total > 0; qnf_resonance_score within [0, 1].
test_cases.actual_output: qnf_bus_messages_total: 1847 (incrementing). qnf_intent_count: 312. qnf_topic_count: 28. qnf_threads_total: 19. qnf_resonance_score: 0.71. All expected metrics present and within valid ranges.
test_cases.notes: Observability stack functional under stress. Prometheus endpoint responding correctly. Metrics accurate and incrementing as expected throughout load run.
